title: The Boar King
text: Pigs as big as carts root through a ruined village, tusks ploughing up the floors of houses. The air stinks of them. The biggest wears a rusted crown wedged on one tusk, and the others give way wherever it walks.

options.label: The quickest snatches the crown off its tusk, and runs for their life.

outcomes.text: Crown in hand, and the whole herd thundering behind, squealing murder.
Too slow. A tusk opens the leg to the bone, and the Boar King keeps its crown.

options.label: Leave food, and slip past while they are busy eating.

outcomes.text: The herd is busy, grunting and tearing. You are not interesting, for now. You hope it stays that way.

options.label: Hunt the king, and take its crown by right of the spear.

outcomes.text: It is a king for a reason, and its subjects come when it calls.
